::: {.hero-panel}
This portfolio documents my hands-on work for **ISSS608 Visual Analytics and Applications**. It brings together geospatial data handling, thematic mapping, spatial point-pattern analysis, spatio-temporal analysis, and spatial weights using R.

Use the **Hands-on Exercises**, **In-Class Exercise**, and **Take-home Exercises** menus in the navigation bar, or select an exercise below.
:::

## Hands-on exercises

::: {.exercise-grid}
::: {.exercise-card}
### [Hands-on Exercise 1a](Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex01a/Hands-on_Ex01a.qmd)

**Geospatial Data Wrangling with R**

Import, inspect, project, wrangle, and analyse spatial data with `sf` and the tidyverse.
:::

::: {.exercise-card}
### [Hands-on Exercise 1b](Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex01b/Hands-on_Ex01b.qmd)

**Choropleth Mapping with R**

Build static and interactive thematic maps and complement them with statistical graphics.
:::

::: {.exercise-card}
### [Hands-on Exercise 2a](Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex02a/Hands-on_Ex02a.qmd)

**First-order Spatial Point Patterns**

Explore nearest-neighbour analysis and kernel density estimation for spatial events.
:::

::: {.exercise-card}
### [Hands-on Exercise 2b](Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex02b/Hands-on_Ex02b.qmd)

**Second-order Spatial Point Patterns**

Study spatial interaction across distances with G-, F-, K-, and L-functions.
:::

::: {.exercise-card}
### [Hands-on Exercise 3](Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex03/Hands-on_Ex03.qmd)

**Spatio-temporal Point Patterns**

Analyse how event intensity and spatial patterns change over time.
:::

::: {.exercise-card}
### [Hands-on Exercise 4](Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex04/Hands-on_Ex04.qmd)

**Spatial Weights and Applications**

Construct contiguity and distance-based neighbours, standardise their weights, and calculate spatially lagged GDP per capita.
:::

:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Each exercise page follows the corresponding course chapter and provides a dedicated place for the worked analysis, interpretation, and outputs.
:::
